title.zh: Coldcard exploiter moves 45% of funds stolen from ‘Wave 3’ attacks, Galaxy says
title.en: Coldcard exploiter moves 45% of funds stolen from ‘Wave 3’ attacks, Galaxy says

current_state.zh: Coldcard Wave 3攻击者已转移约45%的被盗比特币，采用THORChain和CoinJoin混币方式；所有波次中82%的被盗资金仍在原始地址，18%已转移用于洗钱；攻击操作仍在进行中，且可能发现新的受害者。
current_state.en: The Coldcard Wave 3 exploiter has moved ~45% of stolen Bitcoin via THORChain and CoinJoin; across all waves, 82% of stolen funds remain in original addresses and 18% have been moved for laundering; the operation is ongoing and may have uncovered an additional victim.

updates.title_zh: Coldcard third-wave attacker moves 45% of stolen Bitcoin
updates.title_en: Coldcard third-wave attacker moves 45% of stolen Bitcoin
updates.what_changed_zh: 攻击者通过THORChain和CoinJoin转移资金；所有波次中82%的被盗比特币仍留在原始地址；创建了293个多签金库，并已转移其中11个最大金库的资金；发现了一个可能属于另一受害者的未知金库。
updates.what_changed_en: Attacker moved funds via THORChain and CoinJoin; across all waves, 82% of stolen Bitcoin remains in original addresses; created 293 multisig vaults and moved funds from the 11 largest; identified a previously unknown vault likely holding another victim's funds.
updates.current_state_zh: Coldcard Wave 3攻击者已转移约45%的被盗比特币，采用THORChain和CoinJoin混币方式；所有波次中82%的被盗资金仍在原始地址，18%已转移用于洗钱；攻击操作仍在进行中，且可能发现新的受害者。
updates.current_state_en: The Coldcard Wave 3 exploiter has moved ~45% of stolen Bitcoin via THORChain and CoinJoin; across all waves, 82% of stolen funds remain in original addresses and 18% have been moved for laundering; the operation is ongoing and may have uncovered an additional victim.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: The Coldcard third-wave attacker has moved 45% of stolen Bitcoin via THORChain and CoinJoin, with 82% of all stolen funds still in original addresses.
